state: Can is agent-first: correct semantics, explicit contracts and edit reliability are hard gates; full tokens per successful task are secondary. Human visual taste is not a goal and no outside users require compatibility. Positional nominal record construction follows declaration order; adjacent int total and int recent show a same-type reorder risk, but no controlled production misbinding has been observed. Strong domain types, named factories and with replacements are available; a factory merely forwarding two ints does not remove the ambiguity. Calls, constructors and assertions currently use one physical line. A review counted 154 example lines above 120 characters, longest 336, but no agent failure was measured. Precise spans and a comment-preserving formatter are already accepted; multiline syntax is deferred. The checker rejects some immediately forwarded locals such as meaningful permitted, with no quantified agent cost. Compare creation, same-type reorder/rename, long-form edit, parser/formatter repair and meaningful versus redundant local on the same controlled agent task. Keep nominal immutability, evaluation order and assertion behavior. This selects trials, not exact syntax or policy.

di22_fields.instructions: Which next trial should resolve whether named-field construction reduces same-type reorder errors?

criteria.positional_controls: Retain positional construction with stronger domain types or genuinely safe factories; compare silent swaps and agent repairs against the baseline.
criteria.named_form_trial: Prototype nominal named-field construction with duplicate, missing and unknown checks plus defined evaluation order; measure reorder safety.
criteria.tooling_trial: Try a checked constructor rewrite or suspicious reorder diagnostic; quantify missed edits and false positives.

di23a_layout.instructions: Which layout trial should follow accepted formatter and span work if long-form repair remains costly?

criteria.formatter_first: Complete canonical comment-preserving formatting, precise spans and refactor helpers under current one-line grammar; measure repair outcomes.
criteria.delimited_continuation: Only for remaining measured failures, trial newline-as-whitespace inside explicit delimiters with specified comments, trailing separators and recovery.

di23b_local.instructions: Which validity-policy trial should test an immediately forwarded but meaningful local?

criteria.hard_rule_fix: Retain rejection with a precise diagnostic and safe automatic inline fix; measure whether it prevents mistakes or costs repairs.
criteria.advisory_lint: Allow the local and report style advice, preserving an intentionally named step; check evaluation and agent completion.
criteria.semantic_only_rule: Reserve hard errors for a demonstrable semantic ambiguity, with exact negative examples; make pure style cases advisory.
